periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented at approximately a 45-degree angle relative to the horizontal facial midline, slanting downwards towards the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with an approximate 1.6:1 length-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced tapering at the inferior margin towards the snout, creating an asymmetrical tear-drop profile.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shape curvature at the posterior boundary of the dark transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, occupying approximately 40-50% of the visible dorsal torso area.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded, semi-circular convex curvature visible on the superior pinna.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible open-mouth posture exposing lower dentition and the soft tissue of the tongue.
